dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: It's completely furnished, is well-placed, enjoys good lighting... Yes, this bedroom will do just fine.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Some members of the aristocracy hanker after decorations of luxury and beauty, but arrange the room in an absolutely horrific manner... I detest such aristocratic customs.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: But this place... now this a place one can really relax.
